name: comarkserv
title: Comarkserv
description: Preview markdown files and folders in the browser with comarkserv: live reload, search, 580+ themes.
author: matteo_rigoni

commands.name: preview
commands.title: Preview Markdown
commands.subtitle: comarkserv
commands.description: Open the markdown file or the folder that is selected in Finder, with live reload.

commands.name: previews
commands.title: Markdown Previews
commands.subtitle: comarkserv
commands.description: Show the running previews and the recent folders. Open, copy or stop a preview.

commands.name: themes
commands.title: Search Markdown Themes
commands.subtitle: comarkserv
commands.description: Search the base16, base24 and Omarchy themes, see their colors and choose the default.

preferences.name: theme
preferences.title: Default Theme
preferences.description: The theme for new previews, as for --theme. Search Markdown Themes can change it.

preferences.name: command
preferences.title: comarkserv Command
preferences.description: The command that starts comarkserv. Empty: comarkserv if it is installed, else npx comarkserv.
